summary: The requirement document describes one system for four schools with about 6,000 students, covering online admissions, fee collection, attendance, marks and report cards, homework and timetables. Parents get an Android and iPhone app and SMS in Hindi and English, and principals see dashboards across the schools. Old student records are moved from the existing fees program and the vendor supports the system for three years.

stories: As a parent, I can apply for admission online by filling the student's details
As a parent, I can upload the birth certificate and photo with the application

evidence.quote: Admission applications shall be checked by the admission office and approved by the principal.

As a principal, I can approve an admission application
